title.narrative: Supporting Emergency Livelihoods Recovery for Recent Returnees in Aweil West County of NBEGS, South Sudan

description.narrative: The Project Title is "Supporting Emergency Livelihoods Recovery for Recent Returnees in Aweil West County of NBEGS, South Sudan". The project Goal is "to enhance food and livelihoods security for 3000 people (500 smallholder households) while fostering peaceful re-integration and environmental health in Aweil West County of NBEGS, South Sudan". The project uses a participatory, community-driven approach that emphasizes collaboration, coordination and effective communications with key stakeholders, including local authorities as well as the line Ministry of Agriculture and Food Security (MAFS) and Ministry of Environment and Forestry (MOEF). Through consultations, group discussions, and regular coordination meetings, the project ensures inclusivity and alignment with local priorities. The key features of the methodology include: safeguarging affected people (people receiving assistance, children, at-risks adults and people with disabilities), community engagement, capacity building, gender and youth inclusion and monitoring and learning. Activity 1. Project inception/launch Activity 1.1.2. Procure locally or nationally and distribute improved seed varieties and some nutrient-dense tubers materials to the registered household farmers Activity 1.2.2. Procure locally and distribute 160 goats (4 goats per household; 3female and 1 male goats) to 40 households Activity 1.3.2. Procure and distribute fishing kits (2 spools of swine, 1 coil of monofilament and 2 boxes of Hook per household) to the registered fisherfolk households Activity 1.3.2. Procure and distribute fishing kits (2 spools of swine, 1 coil of monofilament and 2 boxes of Hook per household) to the registered fisherfolk households Activity 1.3.3. Conduct 1 comprehensive training workshop in each of the 4 Bomas on fish processing and management for the fisherfolk beneficiaries Activity 1.4.2. Train 100 selected participants in 4 groups of 25 participants on the basics of entrepreneurship/business skills and VSLA concepts Activity 1.4.3. Provide and monitor cash support (Startup) package to the participants to increase their products and services for income generation Activity 2.1.2. Identify and rank 1-2 measures or types of community assets, e.g. dykes, drainage channels etc.in each selected Boma Activity 2.1.3. Support the four groups with funds to rehabilitate or create the selected measures / community assets through labor intensive public work (LIPW) Activity 2.1.4. Community awareness campaigns on disaster preparedness Activity 3.1.2. Train the Peace committees in peacebuilding and social-cohesion activities Activity 3.2.2. Train the youth groups in peacebuilding and social cohesion activities
